blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Which of these mean seven less than a number x? Choose all that apply.
blocks.display: Select all that mean “seven less than a number x”.

blocks.text: x minus seven. Start from x and take away seven. Right.
Negative seven plus x. Adding in a different order gives the same value as x minus seven.
Seven minus x starts from seven, so it is the opposite order. Not a match.
x plus seven adds. Less than means subtract.
Seven x multiplies. Not a match.
Two of them mean seven less than x: x minus seven, and negative seven plus x. Less than starts from the number and takes seven away.
